camel_example: aliyun vod SubmitSnapshotJob --region cn-hangzhou --VideoId d3e680e618708efbf2cae7cc93120000 --ReferenceId '123-123' --SnapshotTemplateId f5b228fe693bf55bd87b7890000 --UserData 'MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://.example.aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_example_:_www' --SpecifiedOffsetTimes '[1000]' --Height 720 --SpecifiedOffsetTime 0 --Count 1 --SpriteSnapshotConfig 'CellWidth_:_120,_CellHeight_:_68,_Columns_:_3,_Lines_:_10,_Padding_:_20,_Margin_:_50' --Width 1280 --Interval 1
description_en: Submits a video snapshot job to start asynchronous snapshot processing
description_zh: 调用本接口提交视频截图作业，开始异步截图处理
kebab_example: aliyun vod submit-snapshot-job --video-id d3e680e618708efbf2cae7cc93120000 --specified-offset-time 0 --width 1280 --height 720 --count 1 --interval 1 --sprite-snapshot-config CellWidth_:_120,_CellHeight_:_68,_Columns_:_3,_Lines_:_10,_Padding_:_20,_Margin_:_50 --snapshot-template-id f5b228fe693bf55bd87b7890000 --user-data MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://.example.aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_example_:_www --specified-offset-times 1000 --reference-id 123-123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitSnapshotJob

parameters.help_en:
The video ID. You can obtain the video ID by using one of the following methods:
For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the video ID.
Obtain the video ID from the value of the VideoId response parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
After the video is uploaded, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time for the snapshot.

Unit: milliseconds.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
截图指定时间的起始点。

单位：毫秒。
默认值：0
parameters.name: specified_offset_time

parameters.help_en: The snapshot width. Valid values: `[8,4096]`. Default value: the source video width. Unit: px
parameters.help_zh: 截图宽，取值范围：`[8,4096]`，默认原片宽，单位：px
parameters.name: width

parameters.help_en: The snapshot height. Valid values: `[8,4096]`. Default value: the source video height. Unit: px
parameters.help_zh: 截图高，取值范围：`[8,4096]`，默认原片高，单位：px
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of snapshots. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 截图的最大数量。默认值：1
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot interval. The value must be greater than or equal to 0.
Unit: seconds.
Default value: 1.
If Interval is set to 0, snapshots are evenly captured based on the value of Count and the video duration
parameters.help_zh:
截图的间隔时间，必须大于或等于0。
单位：秒。
默认值：1。
Interval为0时，表示按照Count数根据视频时长平均截图
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The sprite configuration. If this parameter is not empty, a sprite is generated. For more information about the parameter structure, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html
parameters.help_zh: 生成雪碧图的配置信息。如果不为空则生成雪碧图。参数结构详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html
parameters.name: sprite_snapshot_config

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot template ID.
We recommend that you create a snapshot template first and then pass the snapshot template ID. For more information about how to create a snapshot template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99406.html.
If you pass the snapshot template ID, all request parameters except Action and VideoId are ignored
parameters.help_zh:
截图模板ID。
推荐先创建截图模板，再传递截图模板ID。截图模板创建详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99406.html。
如果传递截图模板ID，会忽略除Action、VideoId之外的请求参数
parameters.name: snapshot_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom settings. Only JSON strings are supported. You can use this parameter to pass through custom data and specify callback URL settings. For more information about the parameter structure, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html.

To use the message callback in this parameter, configure the HTTP callback URL and select the corresponding callback event types in the console. Otherwise, the callback settings do not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
自定义设置。仅支持JSON字符串，支持用户自定义数据透传及指定回调地址设置等。参数结构详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html。

此参数中消息回调的使用前提是需要在控制台配置HTTP回调地址和勾选对应的回调事件类型才能使用，否则回调设置不生效
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The points in time at which snapshots are captured. Unit: milliseconds. You can specify up to 30 points in time at a time
parameters.help_zh: 指定视频时间点进行截图，单位：毫秒。一次可指定最多30个时间点
parameters.name: specified_offset_times

parameters.help_en: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. Length: 6 to 64 characters. The value must be unique at the user level
parameters.help_zh: 自定义 ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
parameters.name: reference_id
